name: Teruo Sakumo
source: He is Kasukabe's father, and used to work for Sayoko's husband Takayuki, but was expelled after trying to rape Sayoko, and ended up getting divorced by his wife. So, in revenge, he killed Takayuki, faking it as an accident, and tricked Sayoko and her daughters, taking them to the village to be gang-raped.
